meta.name: Sinoky 连句模板库 · 初版
meta.note: 模式1=半句补全(completion) 模式3=连接词选择(connectors) 模式2=关键词连词(keywords)。拼音由前端 pinyin-pro 运行时生成，不入库。

completion.en: I got up late, so I was late.
Although I'm tired today, I'm very happy.
If I could speak Chinese, I would travel to China.
It's too hot, I want to drink ice water.

completion.front: 因为这个电影很有意思，
completion.en: Because the movie is interesting, I watched it once more.
If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go to the park.
I study Chinese every day, because I want to work in China.
The more you practice, the better you speak.

connectors.full: 他迟到了，所以没赶上火车。
connectors.en: He was late, so he missed the train.

connectors.full: 下雨了，但是我们还是去爬山了。
connectors.en: It rained, but we still went hiking.

connectors.full: 我很想学中文，但是我没有时间。
connectors.en: I really want to learn Chinese, but I have no time.

connectors.full: 今天很冷，所以我穿了三件衣服。
connectors.en: It's cold today, so I wore three layers.
You should listen more, and also speak more.

connectors.full: 你要是早点睡觉，明天就不会累。
connectors.en: If you sleep earlier, you won't be tired tomorrow.
He left, and he even forgot his phone.

connectors.full: 我不去公园了，因为外面在下雨。
connectors.en: I'm not going to the park, because it's raining.

keywords.en: The game was cancelled because of rain.

keywords.sample: 虽然中文很难，但是很有趣。
keywords.en: Although Chinese is hard, it's interesting.
I go home first, then eat.
I walk while listening to music.

keywords.sample: 要是明天天晴，我们就去打球。
keywords.en: If it's sunny tomorrow, we'll play ball.
The more you practice, the better you get.
